title: Character witness from high acceptance
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in $n$ variables, and let $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$. For every Boolean input $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ and Boolean proof $p$ of length $2^n+2^{n^2}$, if the associated quadratic PCPP verifier accepts with probability at least $1-\varepsilon/100000$, then there is a vector $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ satisfying every equation in $L$ such that the proof table’s linear part differs from the linear function $x\mapsto\langle\gamma,x\rangle$ on at most a $(3\varepsilon/1000)$ fraction of inputs. Its matrix part likewise differs on at most a $(3\varepsilon/1000)$ fraction of matrices from the function $A\mapsto\langle A,\gamma\gamma^{\mathsf T}\rangle$, where both pairings are over $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations
